spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal.

f. du. (-चौ)
The buttocks.
E.
स्फाय to swell, डिच् aff. or स्फिट to hurt, aff. क्विप्, form irr.

r. 10th cl. (स्फेटयति)
1 To hurt, to injure, or kill.
2 To cover.

r. 10th cl. (स्फिट्टयति)
1 To hurt, to injure, to kill.
2 To dwell.
3 To give.
4 To be strong.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Much, many.
E.
स्फाय to swell, किरच् aff. deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Much, many.
2 Swollen, enlarged.
3 Successful, prosperous, risen in rank or fortune.
4 Affected by hereditary disease.
E.
स्फायी to swell, aff. क्त; also स्फात.

f. (-तिः)
1 Increase, enlargement.
2 Prosperity.
E.
स्फाय to swell, क्तिन् aff.
